name: ScreenWave
tagline: A sensor glove that moves the cursor and clicks with a finger tap, for presenting without a mouse.
problem: Screens and projectors limit natural interaction in classrooms and studios.
solution: Accelerometers and magnetometers on a glove, read by Arduinos, map hand rotation to cursor movement and a finger tap to clicks.
demo_moment: Team-described: steer a presentation by rotating your hand.

why_it_stood_out.claim: A wearable that replaces the mouse in a room.

lessons: A wearable input device demos well when the audience can try it.
